breath.songTitle: I Saw Her for the First Time
breath.line: When she walked in I held my breath
stanza: When she walked in I held my breath
I thought I might just die
When she came way and she caught my eye
I felt like I could cry

breath.line: Down to the very last breath
stanza: The children on Melrose strut their stuff
Is absolute zero cold enough?
And out in the valley, warm and clean
The little ones sit by the TV screen
No thoughts to think
No tears to cry
All sucked dry
Down to the very last breath

breath.line: Spread your arms and hold your breath
stanza: Well, he's one of those who knows
That life is just a leap of faith
Spread your arms and hold your breath
And always trust your cape
You laugh until you cry
You cry until you laugh
And everyone must breathe
Until their dying breath

breath.line: Eventually the dying man takes his final breath
stanza: Eventually the dying man takes his final breath
But first checks his news feed to see what he's 'bout to miss
And it occurs to him a little late in the game
We leave as clueless as we came
From the rented heavens to the shadows in the cave
We'll all be wrong someday

breath.line: 'Cause I felt I had to justify each breath
stanza: So I went running down a list of things
Some were real, but on some of them, I lied
'Cause I felt I had to justify each breath
That I'd been breathing in this life
Then I realized I was playing into someone else's rules
Trying to keep my score up in a game I did not choose
Then I looked that ghost straight in the eye
And said "You had better not be coming back by again"

breath.line: I can smell the sorrow on your breath
stanza: Look up, and what do you see?
All of you and all of me, fluorescent and starry
And some of them, they surprise
I can't look it in the eyes, Seconal, Spanish fly, absinthe, kerosene
Cherry-flavored neck and collar
I can smell the sorrow on your breath
The sweat, the victory and sorrow, the smell of fear
I got it
*Jay Som - Everybody Works
*Flume - Hi This Is Flume (Mixtape)
The Internet - Ego Death

death.line: With it's very own breath of brandy and Death
stanza: This waltz, this waltz, this waltz, this waltz
With it's very own breath of brandy and Death
Dragging it's tail in the sea

death.line: Amused itself to death, it has amused itself to death
stanza: Amused itself to death, it has amused itself to death
Amused itself to death
Well, what is this craziness?
This crazy talking?
You caught some small death
When you were sleepwalking

death.line: Oh let me take my chances on the wall of death
stanza: Let me ride on the wall of death one more time
Let me ride on the wall of death one more time
You can waste your time on the other rides
This is the nearest to being alive
Oh let me take my chances on the wall of death

death.line: "'Cause one man's dream is another man's death"
stanza: "'Cause one man's dream is another man's death"
I remember when you told me that
Didn't know what to say, so I just laughed
But now I know it's not funny
When I get back
I will bleed after my beating
Don't leave me here
Don't leave me here
I'm scared to death

death.line: To exist in the face of suffering and death
stanza: Is this how it is?
Is this how it's always been?
To exist in the face of suffering and death
And somehow still keep singing?
Oh, like Christ up on a cross
Who died for us, who died for what?
Oh, don't you wanna call it off?
But there is nothing else that I know how to do
But to open up my arms and give it all to you
Take me to church
I'll worship like a dog at the shrine of your lies
I'll tell you my sins and you can sharpen your knife
Offer me that deathless death
Oh, good God, let me give you my life
Take me to church
I'll worship like a dog at the shrine of your lies
I'll tell you my sins and you can sharpen your knife
Offer me that deathless death
Oh, good God, let me give you my life
